authority_boundary: Founder intent and architecture semantics only. This receipt does not manufacture physical, empirical, mission-readiness, medical/biological, legal, regulatory, certification or publication evidence.
resolution_rule: Overlay -> validate against current owning Drive/CGX records -> Resolve -> DBR/readback. Preserve existing IDs/owners and do not create a parallel master.

confirmed_direction.subject: Thin physical .cgx identity
semantics: A printed or hybrid physical technology may carry its own stable CGX node/object identity and capability manifest without carrying the complete compute stack of a smartphone-class device.
Identity, local sensing/actuation and bounded state may be thin; registered deterministic compute may be delegated through the existing CGX node-exchange lease/readback contract.
Node identity never transfers semantic, governance, certification or release authority.

confirmed_direction.subject: Function-as-material-and-geometry stack
semantics: Printable technology is represented as qualified material layers, interfaces, geometry, process sequence and environment rather than as a monolithic device category.

Structural, conductive, dielectric, sensing, thermal, fluidic, optical, electromagnetic and energy-storage functions may be combined only where the constituent physics, manufacturing resolution, interfaces and evidence allow.
Recursive modular printing expands capability through separately calibrated child modules; it is not an unconstrained self-replication claim.

confirmed_direction.subject: Structural energy shell
semantics: External shells and internal cavities may be co-designed for structure, thermal control, shielding and electrochemical/electrostatic storage where qualified.
Graphene/carbon is a candidate feed family, not a universally preferred material.
Free space or void is geometry/working volume and is never itself an energy source.

confirmed_direction.subject: Eco-Grex circular feed coupling
semantics: Land/ocean cleanup streams may enter the manufacturing graph only through collection, sorting, decontamination, assay, material-passport and application-specific qualification.
Recovered plastic, carbon, metal, glass/mineral and bio-derived fractions may become local feed where contamination, leachate, corrosion, toxicity, microplastic, worker and ecological gates pass.
Cleanup benefit does not waive material or product qualification.

confirmed_direction.subject: Local-horizon production
semantics: Local horizon means the bounded resources, processes, energy, environment, evidence and authority available to a node: terrestrial, ocean, orbital, lunar, Martian, asteroid, interplanetary or later interstellar.
CGX may compile candidate local production routes and minimum-import seed lists under hard safety/ecology/rights/authority/evidence constraints.
Self-organisation means distributed planning, handshake and safe fallback; it does not imply autonomous governance or extraction authority.

confirmed_direction.subject: Bootstrap outpost scenario
semantics: A minimum-skeleton outpost architecture should be evaluated in which imported seed hardware bootstraps assay, tagging, feed preparation, manufacturing, repair and local safeguard capability.

The founder-proposed three-Mark-III plus Mark-V registry/telemetry/tagging support arrangement is corroborated by Type 1 Systems Solar Hull UC-005 at design stage: registry/telemetry node casing and low-power support. It still requires full mission engineering and must not be promoted to ownership/yield or flight-readiness claims.
Resource return/value may remain an economic option but never outranks mission safety, debris stewardship, planetary/ecological constraints or evidence gates.

confirmed_direction.subject: Filespace + dataspace + solid-state triplet
semantics: Filespace holds identity, semantics, provenance, recipes and evidence references; dataspace holds live state, telemetry, execution and results; solid-state/physical space holds qualified material geometry and actuation.
One object lineage may bind all three through snapshot/hash/handshake/readback/DBR without confusing representation with authority.
The triplet is a portable typed contract ('new neutral') rather than a claim that all physical substrates are interchangeable.

confirmed_direction.subject: Functional coatings and infrastructure feedback
semantics: Road, building and habitat surfaces may be explored as two-, three- or multi-layer protective, reflective, conductive, heating, sensing, RF/EM or optical coating stacks.
Geospatial sensor feedback and adaptive infrastructure control are legitimate test targets.
Biological or resonant-health effects remain unvalidated hypotheses unless supported by controlled empirical evidence.

confirmed_direction.subject: AI helper and portfolio rollout
semantics: A CGX helper interface should scale the same evidence-governed build graph from individual/DIY use through businesses, governments and nonprofit/volunteer programmes.
The interface may guide assembly, recipe selection, qualification and troubleshooting but must refuse or escalate high-consequence actions outside current qualified capability.
As complexity rises, the same micro layer/interface model should compose into macro modules, facilities and supply-chain nodes.

confirmed_direction.subject: Physical-object identity lifecycle
semantics: A printed or hybrid object may carry its own stable .cgx identity, build/material lineage, capability manifest, evidence ceiling and DBR pointer while delegating heavy compute through C0/C1/C2 separation.
Physical identity is a machine-readable passport/network address and never confers semantic, certification, release, mission, extraction or governance authority.

confirmed_direction.subject: Printer-family operational decomposition
semantics: The printable technology catalogue composes through seven process-cell families: macro structural; precision functional/solid-state; fiber/wire/coil; hybrid seed assembly; Eco-Grex feed conditioning; metrology/finish/repair; and mobile/roaming UTP.
Macro and micro are one manufacturing grammar at different process envelopes; specialist seed components remain explicit until local capability is independently qualified.

confirmed_direction.subject: Capability closure metrics and RUVR alias hold
semantics: Local function coverage, qualified local-feed fraction, critical import dependency, local repairability, verification, safe-state coverage, ecological acceptance, authority closure and uncertainty are retained as independent dimensions.
No exact canonical RUVR definition was found in the reconciled corpus, so these dimensions must not be renamed or collapsed into RUVR until an owner-defined mapping exists.

frontier_projections.scope: nonprofit/public-benefit cleanup, education, local fabrication and monitoring
semantics: Use a small qualified front/back technical core for engineering, QA, safety, data, governance and escalation.
Allow a larger paid/benefit volunteer, citizen-science and field-operator population through role-scoped interfaces, training, receipts and safe task envelopes.
Volunteer participation never inherits specialist manufacturing, chemical, electrical, orbital, ecological-release or canonical authority.
Reuse the same local-horizon compiler, node identity and evidence contracts across jurisdictions while retaining local law, data sovereignty, export/customs, safety and ecological controls.
InterSol may act as a terrestrial/space-logistics and manufacturing-support hub only to the extent supported by its owning configuration.
Interoperability does not create supra-national ownership, governance or release authority.

Treat atmosphere, hydrology, geochemistry, radiation, thermal balance, ecology, closed-loop habitat systems and material cycles as coupled state variables rather than as a single terraforming technology.
Apply the same material-passport, local-horizon, ecological externality, evidence and safe-state rules before any planetary-scale intervention concept can progress.
Planetary protection, irreversible change, biological release, governance and multi-generational externalities are hard gates.
Scale the same filespace/dataspace/physical contracts from devices to infrastructure, habitats, logistics, energy and resource networks.
Optimise for sufficiency, resilience, ecological health, recoverability and distributed capability rather than extraction or energy throughput alone.
Civilisation-scale framing is a systems-planning horizon and is not present technological readiness evidence.
Assume long communications delay, stronger local safe-state autonomy, provenance continuity, repair/manufacturing closure and bounded decision authority.
The same CGX identity/lease/receipt grammar may be reused conceptually, but transport, energy, biology and mission feasibility remain independent frontier problems.
